title: Contextual route replay bundles for debug and SLO correlation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a lightweight, privacy-aware bundle format that captures the context necessary to deterministically replay a routing decision across region/tier/model-variant boundaries. The goal is fast root-cause debugging and automated SLO correlation without shipping full raw payloads or unredacted PII to long-term archives. Bundles should be small (<=100KB typical), indexable by trace ID and route fingerprint, and consumable by an internal replay harness and the Console playback UI.
design_notes: Bundle components: 1) canonical request metadata (route id, timestamp, region, tier policy id), 2) minimal request shape with PII masked or hashed, 3) per-decision frames: chosen node/model-variant, latency ms, queue time, capacity tier, policy rationale token, cost-estimate token, and a compact KV-cache diff snapshot, 4) deterministic pseudo-random seed and input token prefix needed to reproduce batching/kv-cache effects in the runtime simulator, 5) playback hints (required model binary version, quantization profile). Compression + gzip + base64 for storage. Retention default 30 days; opt-in longer retention for enterprise customers.
